messages:
mira: noticing CPU tail on host ingress after recent kernel policy tweak. p50 tokenize up ~18% for small reqs. profiler shows parse->tokenize->writev chain.

dan: which policy? the adaptive_coalesce one we tested last week?

mira: yes. sample log: `parse_ms=1.05 tok_ms=0.88 writev_small=140 coalesce=true kernel=adaptive_coalesce_v1 seq_len=30`

oliver: kv metrics also show increased evictions and lower hitrate (0.88 -> 0.77). coalesce might be creating transient prefix variants.

mira: flame excerpt pasted: ```
900ms total
  380ms host::parse_frame
  340ms tokenizer::tokenize_fast
  120ms net::writev_small
  60ms kvcache::evict_sample
```

dan: tokenizer being that high is odd. we didn't touch tokenizer. could be duplicate parsing if coalesce requires a second pass to normalize frames.

terry: quick mitigation: gate coalesce behind seq_len threshold (<48 disable). also add a sampler host_penalty term so kernel scoring isn't GPU-only.

oliver: agree. i'll add a lightweight host_parse_ms metric tagged by kernel choice (rolling 5m). should give live telemetry for scoring.

deploy-bot: deploy-notify: adaptive_coalesce_v1 rollout to canary cluster-c7 at 2025-05-18T11:40:02Z

mira: can we rollback canary until we have host_penalty scoring in place? customer-facing latency impact is visible on a few services.

dan: i'll flip rollback. also creating small-chat replay harness (avg seq 26) to validate changes locally.

oliver: follow-ups: 1) sampler PR to add host_penalty into score (gamma tunable); 2) kvcache dedupe window to collapse near-identical prefixes for N ms; 3) add e2e job that fails on host p50 regress >10% for small-chat trace.

terry: +1. i'll prototype gamma=0.5 and run sim. early runs show it prefers legacy kernel for chatty traces and avoids increased smallwrites.

deploy-bot: rollback-notify: adaptive_coalesce_v1 rollback completed at 2025-05-18T11:42:18Z on cluster-c7

mira: post-rollback quick check: host p50 back to normal, kvcache hit nudged back to 0.86. good.

dan: logging tasks in tracker: RUNTIME-894, will attach traces and harness.

mira: thanks all. we'll re-roll with host-aware scoring and dedupe in a canary after tests pass.
